input.file_text:
# PR #648 review (fixrev-plugin lane, 2026-10-09)

- PR #648 by od-studio-webagency (closes #637): wraps Unix plugin commands in `sh scripts/with-bun.sh`, adds `scripts/bun-path.sh`. Head 6ad99ad. Review-only lane; nothing merged or pushed.
- Bug is real, in v0.4.2 and main: herdr started with `PATH=/usr/bin:/bin` fails every Unix plugin command when Bun is only in `~/.bun/bin`.
- Verdict: merge-after-fixes. Review: https://github.com/devswha/herdr-web-ui/pull/648#pullrequestreview-5466628098 . Report: `~/.dori/reports/fixrev-plugin.json`.
- Maintainer fixes needed: quoted `add_dir` per directory and absolute paths only in `bun-path.sh` (space in HOME misses Bun, or runs a `bun` from a sibling directory); `${HOME:-}` guard (preflight runs under `set -u`); keep `~/.local/bin` before mise shims (fallback Node order); test PATH without host bun/node plus a space-in-HOME case; `printf` for the error; CHANGELOG conflict with #632, link and `by @od-studio-webagency`; release note that existing installs need a plugin reinstall (in-app updater and install.sh do not refresh the manifest).
- Codex pass for this lane: the owner required `gpt-6.1-sol` xhigh (not astra); Codex over-rated severities (High/Medium) and gave a wrong author handle.

## QA scenario: plugin manifest commands on a real isolated herdr
- Fake HOME with only `~/.bun/bin/bun` (symlink), own `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, env `PATH=/usr/bin:/bin`.
- `herdr plugin link <checkout>`; write `PORT=<free>`, `HOST=127.0.0.1`, `OVIS_TOKEN=`, `OVIS_STATE_DIR=<tmp>` into `$(herdr plugin config-dir devswha.herdr-web-ui)/.env`.
- Start `herdr --session herdr-web-ui-test-<name> server` with that env; poll `/api/health` with a deadline; read `herdr --session ... plugin log list`; stop the app with `plugin action invoke devswha.herdr-web-ui.stop`, then kill the server.
- The checkout needs `bun install` and `bun run build` first for the app to start.

## Gotchas
- `herdr worktree create` must be given `--workspace <repo parent workspace id>`; `--cwd` of a linked worktree fails with `linked_worktree_source`.
- `bun run check fast` and `bun run check run` share one lane lock: run them one after the other.
